name: Sasha
source: Owner of the General Store near Rakshek. She is very fond of [url=/c3685]Croix[/url] and [url=/c55886]Cloche[/url], and looks like she has a little liking to [url=/c3688]Luca[/url], too. She usually refers to Croix as "Cro-nii" and Cloche as "Cro-nee".
